mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, reflected in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the prior month's average (t-test p > 0.05) during confirmed inflation spikes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS labor cost growth above 2% for two consecutive months predicts a tightening labor market, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under such labor conditions are not significantly above the 90-day moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST industrial production exceeding 2% signals strengthening domestic demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by more than 2% in the current month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite the signal, and IC < -0.05 over a 30-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO supply index below 92.0, following an expansionary phase, predicts a supply-side constraint that pushes S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 92.0 after a multi-month expansion
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or flat during confirmed supply tightness (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.0% for three consecutive months indicates a prolonged easing cycle, which amplifies equity valuation multiples and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day average during such periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months amid a rising labor demand signal (HOUST > 500), it indicates a labor market transition that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and HOUST > 500 for two consecutive months
regime_hint: labor market softening with demand persistence
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite the combined signal (Rank IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RSAFS commercial paper demand coinciding with a FEDFUNDS increase above 4.75% triggers a risk-off cascade that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.75% and RSAFS increases by >5% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain flat or positive despite the combined signal (IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in both INDPRO and GDPC1 (demand and supply) exceeding 2% each, without a compensating rise in HOUST, predicts a structural imbalance that results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO down >2% and GDPC1 down >2% in the same month, while HOUST does not rise >2%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat during such imbalances (IC > 0.1).
